name: Daihatsu Meika
source:
A genius inventor who happens to be the landlady of the apartment all the characters are living in. Meika has unrivalled hacking skills, however she has very poor physical reflexes. Her name is a pun on the phrase "great inventor" (大発明家 Daihatsumei-ka).

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punch_Line_(anime)]Wikipedia[/url]]
